stages.target: seated man in dark navy t-shirt with curly hair and glasses, directly in front (image centre, columns D-E), laptop on lap
stages.affordance: centre of his navy t-shirt torso (chest), image rows 2-4 around column D-E
stages.description: Lift the right arm from rest: shoulder pitch forward and slightly up so the bare right hand tip rises into the camera view at roughly the robot's chest height (about 70 cm above floor, like the demo's 64-79 cm band), staying in front of the robot with the elbow still bent. Do not swing sideways; the target man is centred, so the hand should appear in the lower-centre of the frame, below his torso.
stages.completion: The robot's right hand tip is visible in the lower-centre of the image (around columns D-E, rows 5-6), clearly above the robot's waist level and vertically below the navy-shirt man's torso, with no other person overlapping it.

stages.target: seated man in dark navy t-shirt with curly hair and glasses, directly in front (image centre, columns D-E)
stages.affordance: centre of his navy t-shirt chest, midway between his shoulders and the laptop
stages.description: Straighten the elbow and pitch the shoulder so the arm extends forward toward the man, forearm nearly horizontal or slightly upward, hand tip aimed at the centre of his navy shirt. The hand should move mainly forward (about 10-15 cm) with a small rise, not left toward the empty chair or right toward the people at the table. Stop with the hand tip well short of touching him (about 20-30 cm away).
stages.completion: The right arm appears straight and horizontal in the image with the hand tip lying on top of or immediately in front of the navy t-shirt chest region of the closest seated man (columns D-E, rows 2-4), not over the white chair on the left or the people at the table on the right.

stages.target: seated man in dark navy t-shirt, directly in front
stages.affordance: centre of his navy t-shirt chest
stages.description: Keep the extended right arm motionless with the hand tip still aimed at the centre of the man's navy shirt, holding the pointing pose for a couple of seconds without drifting up, down or sideways.
stages.completion: Across consecutive frames the right hand tip stays fixed in the image over the navy-shirt man's chest region (columns D-E, rows 2-4), the arm remains straight, and no contact with the man is visible.
